description: Search current final Medicare Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), optionally restricted to a state. LCDs are contractor- and jurisdiction-specific and can differ across locations.

query.description: Policy title/topic or LCD number. Omit to browse the most recently updated LCDs — that is the answer to "what changed recently".

state.description: Optional US state name or two-letter abbreviation. California, New York and Missouri span multiple MAC jurisdictions; those resolve to the whole-state jurisdiction and the response reports which one under state_resolved.

name: medicare_lcd_search
title: Medicare Lcd Search
